name: coverage-v3
preregistered: This file is committed before the run and hash-bound as config_sha256 in outputs/coverage-v3/experiment.json. No selection value, support target, arm or proxy was edited after the audit fold was scored. Unlike gapfinder-v2, no wall-clock time is typed into this file: the run records its own started_at.
objective: Choose the emission operating point from the official metric's own algebra instead of a coarse floor grid. Adding one binary emitted pixel changes the DTI denominator by exactly 0.2*(new coverage credit) + 0.2*(1 - k(d)) <= 0.2, so a pixel pays only when it lies within the 300 m kernel of hidden truth that nothing else covers. Coverage is the objective; far-field or redundant mass is pure cost.
buffer_rationale: 30 px feature radius + ridge smoothing/NMS support (~5 px) + 3 px metric kernel = 38 px < 48 px
rotation_disclosure: Half-block rotation of the same 512 px lattice. Fold 2 here is NOT the region gapfinder-v2 audited: every block boundary moved 25.6 km and the train/tune/audit role assignment changed (v2: train 0,1 / tune 2 / audit 3; v3: train 0,3 / tune 1 / audit 2). The footprint necessarily overlaps, so this is a rotation, not an independent survey area.

arms.role: control carried forward from gapfinder-v2: squared-error regression on the triangular-kernel target
new: binary classifier whose positive weight is beta/alpha = 0.8/0.2 = 4, the standard surrogate for the Tversky index the competition actually scores

support_meaning: The floor is set per arm as the value whose oriented-ridge emission would cover that fraction of the tuning fold, giving a 12-level support sweep instead of five coarse floors.

proxies.gap: SGMC fault pixels >= 3.2 px from any known pixel (independent published catalogue)
proxies.all: all SGMC fault pixels not exactly on a known pixel
proxies.known: supplied labels inside the untouched fold interior, scored with known pixels emit-able and tip-extension rays excluded (they are built from those same traces)
proxies.evaluation_mask: template-valid AND NOT known AND fold interior

selection: maximize min(DTI_gap, DTI_all, DTI_known) on the tuning fold among eligible candidates; tie-break lower emitted fraction, then arm id, support target, halo, tip
wide_rule: The third published file is the largest-support eligible candidate of the selected arm whose robust DTI is at least 0.75x the selected candidate's robust DTI. It is a deliberate recall-favouring probe, not a second guess about which file is best.
refit: fraction-consistent sampling as in gapfinder-v2: keep every exact positive and reuse the holdout model's inclusion fractions. Accept only if the support gate passes and the full-grid support is within a factor 1.5 of the holdout model; otherwise publish the unchanged holdout model.

portfolio.fusion: selected emission OR USGS SGMC-gap traces (the leaderboard isolates this by comparing it with ml)
portfolio.ml: selected emission only, no SGMC traces
portfolio.wide: same arm and target at the wide support point; tests whether more coverage beats less on the hidden labels

score_warning: Every local number uses public catalogues, not hidden expert labels. No leaderboard score is implied and no file here has been uploaded.
novelty_vs_gapfinder_v2: support is swept on 12 levels with a data-driven floor instead of 5 hand-picked floors
a beta/alpha-weighted classifier is compared with the regression control
the spatial partition is rotated and the tune/audit roles are reassigned
a third file measures the recall-for-coverage hypothesis directly
the marginal value of every tranche is measured and published, so the next session can see which pixels paid for themselves
